title: Nicoise Salad
subtitle: French salad with tuna, egg, and green beans
excerpt: A classic French salad built on tuna, hard-boiled eggs, green beans, and a sharp mustardy dressing. No fuss and ready in 20 minutes once the potatoes are cooked.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from the classic Nicoise tradition. The dressing ratio of lemon, olive oil, and Dijon is consistent across the most reliable French references.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook the potatoes, eggs, and green beans up to a day ahead. Keep them refrigerated and dress the salad just before serving.

content.text: Everything can be cooked in the same pot of water. Start with the potatoes, add the beans, then finish with the eggs.

items.prepNote: small waxy potatoes, halved and boiled until tender

content.text: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil. Add the potatoes and cook for 12 minutes until just tender.
Add the green beans to the potato water for the last 3 minutes of cooking. Drain both and rinse under cold water.
To hard boil the eggs: lower them into a separate pan of boiling water and cook for 9 minutes. Transfer to cold water, peel, and halve.
Make the dressing. Whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, and Dijon with a pinch of salt.
Arrange the potatoes, green beans, cherry tomatoes, and olives on a large platter. Flake the tuna over the top.
Nestle the egg halves into the salad. Drape the anchovies over if using. Scatter the capers. Drizzle the dressing over everything.

items.symptom: Egg yolks have a grey ring.
items.cause: Eggs were overcooked or not cooled quickly.
items.fix: Cook 9 minutes exactly then cool immediately in cold water.

items.cause: Left in the boiling water too long.
items.fix: 3 minutes only; they should still have a bite.

items.cause: Too much lemon relative to oil.
items.fix: Add another tablespoon of oil and taste again.
